title: Make Money with AI: Freelancing & Small Business Playbook
subtitle: Offer AI-powered services clients pay for, find and win clients honestly, get paid properly, and run your small business smarter.
description:
This course is for anyone in India who wants to earn with AI-powered services or run a small business more efficiently: students, career returners, side-hustlers and shop, clinic or home-business owners. You do not need to code. You need a laptop or smartphone, an internet connection and a few focused hours each week.

You will learn which AI-assisted services clients actually pay for, how to choose a niche, build a portfolio quickly and honestly, price your work in rupees and dollars, and find clients on LinkedIn, Upwork, Fiverr, Instagram, WhatsApp and through your local network. You will also learn the business side that most courses skip: contracts, invoicing, GST and tax basics, international payments, and how to avoid scams.

The course is built around four practical projects: a niche and offer one-pager, a three-piece portfolio, a proposal template with ten personalised outreach messages, and a delivery SOP for one service. By the end you will have a working toolkit, not just notes.

We are honest throughout: AI speeds up first drafts, but quality, trust and communication are still your job. No course can guarantee income, and this one does not. Any prices shown are illustrative examples to help you build your own rate card.
audience: Students who want to earn and build real work experience before placements
Career returners looking for flexible, home-based work
Working professionals building a side income on weekends
Small business owners who want to save time on customers, catalogues and admin
Beginner freelancers who want a clear, ethical system for using AI
outcomes: Choose a profitable niche and package a clear offer clients can say yes to
Build a three-piece portfolio quickly with AI while labelling samples honestly
Set prices in ₹ and $ using a floor-rate method and tiered packages
Write tailored proposals and respectful outreach messages that get conversations started
Deliver AI-assisted work with a review, fact-check and originality process clients trust
Use simple contracts, proper invoices and understand GST and tax basics to discuss with a CA
Set up WhatsApp Business, catalogue descriptions and simple AI-assisted bookkeeping
Spot common freelancing scams and avoid over-promising results
prerequisites: Basic comfort using a computer or smartphone and the internet
Ability to read and write simple English (regional language skills are a bonus)
No coding or prior freelancing experience needed
projects: A one-page niche and offer document defining your ideal client, core package and pricing.
A three-piece portfolio with short case studies that honestly describe how you used AI.
A reusable proposal template plus ten researched, personalised outreach messages ready to send.
A step-by-step delivery SOP for one service, including prompts, checklists and message templates.

faqs.q: Will this course guarantee that I earn money?
faqs.a: No. No honest course can guarantee income, because results depend on your skills, effort, niche and market. What the course gives you is a practical system and four finished projects that make it much easier to find and serve clients. Any prices shown are illustrative examples, not promises.

faqs.q: Do I need any technical or coding skills?
faqs.a: No. The course is designed for beginners. If you can use a browser, a chat app and a basic document or spreadsheet, you can follow every lesson. Optional automation topics use no-code tools.

faqs.q: I run a shop or small business, not a freelance practice. Is this useful for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Module 5 focuses on using AI for customer replies, WhatsApp Business, catalogues, bookkeeping help and SOPs for your team. The pricing, contracts and scam-awareness lessons are also useful for any small business.

faqs.q: Does the course cover GST and income tax for freelancers?
faqs.a: It covers the basics in plain language: invoicing, GST registration thresholds, export of services, TDS and advance tax, plus a list of questions to ask your CA. It is general information, not tax advice, and we recommend consulting a Chartered Accountant for your situation.
Yes. A certificate of completion is issued automatically when you mark every lesson in the course as complete. You can add it to your LinkedIn profile.
You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase, as long as you have completed less than 30% of the course. Just contact support with your order details.
